dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Datasets used for training functional and surface area normative models, and for benchmarking tasks (COBRE, UMich, HCP-YA).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Datasets included the Human Connectome Project (young adult) study, the University of Michigan schizophrenia study, and the Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)... Many sites were pulled from publicly available datasets including ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, NKI-RS, OpenNeuro, PNC, and UKBiobank.
